about_the_game:
🕵️ Who’s the Killer on College?

You’re not just here to study—there’s been a murder on college. As a student living the college life, your ultimate goal is to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight. Talk to your classmates, search for clues, and investigate events from different angles. Each playthrough can lead to a different murderer, making every run a unique mystery experience.

🎓 Live the Full College Experience

Attend lectures, work part-time jobs in the cafeteria, and decorate your dorm room. Gossip in the library, flirt at parties, or just chill in your favorite corner of college. This isn’t just a murder mystery—it’s a full college simulator where your daily life is as important as your investigation.

💡 Clues, Choices, and Changing Outcomes

Your social interactions matter. Will you build trust or make enemies? The way you talk, who you spend time with, and how you explore the school can change what clues you find—or miss. No two investigations are the same.

🌟 Boost Your Prestige and Date the College Star

Increase your prestige score through smart choices, success in class, and social confidence. Rise through the ranks of popularity and unlock the chance to date the most attractive and sought-after students on college. Fame, romance, and mystery—can you handle them all?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Live the wild college life: flirt, study, party, work, and uncover a mysterious murder. Gather clues and expose the killer in this student life sim with a dark twist. Forget classic simulators—can you find out who did it?
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
